additions.note: Hosted video generation and editing with native audio, improved consistency, and clips up to 15 seconds. Generally available in the Gemini API and Gemini for business.
Cybersecurity model for finding and validating exploitable vulnerabilities. Initially available to approved Daybreak Red customers through the API and Codex.
594B mixture-of-experts model with 17B active parameters and image input. Available on Tinker at launch, with Apache-2.0 weights planned after safety testing.
Four open-weight Cosmos 3 checkpoints for interactive world simulation and synchronized multi-sensor driving scenes.
Apache-2.0 coding model based on Qwen3.5-4B that generates Three.js scenes with editable GLB exports. Full Safetensors and GGUF checkpoints are public.
Public 280B mixture-of-experts pre-training checkpoint with 14B active parameters and up to 1M context for inference and fine-tuning. Downloadable weights use Baidu’s model-specific license.
Image-generation family for ChatGPT, Codex, and the API. Adds animated GIFs, SVG output, markup-guided edits, and a complexity setting.

Full 2.8T mixture-of-experts weights with 104B active parameters, native vision, and 1M context under the Kimi K3.1 Pro License. The November 4 public release follows the October hosted launch and a November 2 repository commit.
Apache-2.0 dense text model for reasoning and agentic coding with up to 1M context. Public weights and hosted inference were released together.
Coding model post-trained from Inkling-Small with 276B total and 12B active parameters. Available in Devin Desktop and CLI, with controlled weight access planned for partners and researchers.
Reasoning model post-trained from IBM Granite 4.2 8B. Full weights and a local GGUF build are available under webAI's non-commercial license.
Open-weight Pyramid-JiT text-to-image research model with a published training recipe. November 4 is the lab's release write-up date.
Hosted detection family for AI-generated images and video. The full model supports localization heatmaps and Flash targets higher-throughput screening.
Document extraction model that maps visual documents into a requested set of structured JSON fields.

Hosted multimodal reasoning model with image understanding, coding, and computer use across graphical and command-line interfaces. Vercel confirms API availability November 3, a day before the OpenRouter listing. Public weights were still pending at launch.
Apache-2.0 decision model built on Sarvam 105B. Returns probabilities over supplied answer options for classification, routing, and verification.
Open-weight image generation and editing model distilled from MiniMax H3. Uses eight sampling steps and ships with reduced-precision variants for local inference.

MIT-licensed scientific reasoning model post-trained from GLM-5.3 for chemistry, materials, and life sciences. November 2 records public release evidence, following the October 31 repository creation timestamp.

Apache-2.0 computer-use checkpoint for visual grounding, multi-step GUI actions, and switching to command-line operations. Microsoft uploaded the weights October 30, following its October 29 technical report.
Apache-2.0 diffusion language model with 35B total and 3B active parameters. Public weights and code support reasoning, coding, and generating interfaces.
Trusted-access deployment for qualified life-sciences researchers. Uses GPT-6 Astra weights with a research-specific refusal policy and separate access controls.
Open preview checkpoint for long-context reasoning. October 30 is the dated public model-card update, following the October 28 repository creation timestamp.
Hosted image-to-video model derived using the company's neuron-based optimization. Available through fal and OpenRouter at launch.
689M OCR model for document text and layout, with downloadable weights. The surya-ocr 0.23.0 release uses it by default.
Open-weight MiniMax H3 post-train for video with synchronized audio. Supports text, reference images, and first and last frames, with a separate hosted API.
Hosted speech-to-speech model for voice agents that can call tools during a conversation.
Small MIT-licensed decision model that returns probabilities and confidence for typed questions. Released on Hugging Face and Baseten Model APIs.
Hosted legal model made available in AutoClaw on October 29, before its November 2 OpenRouter listing. Z.ai has not specified its checkpoint relationship to the earlier GLM-Legal beta.
Embodied foundation model for robotic manipulation and post-deployment learning. October 29 records the public unveiling, with public weights planned for later in 2026.
Hosted coding and software-engineering model post-trained for token efficiency, with text and image input, tool calling, and 1M context.
Updated hybrid reasoning checkpoint for coding and agent workflows. October 27 records the initial weight upload, before the October 29 public coverage.
Open-weight Cosmos 3 checkpoint for interactive surgical simulation. Generates video conditioned on instrument motion and endoscope pose, with code and model weights published.
Looped language model with a recurrent block that can run multiple times to trade speed for reasoning depth. NVIDIA dates the BF16 weights October 16, before the November 2 paper.
Open-weight 5B text-to-image model with base and supervised fine-tuned checkpoints, including support for text rendering within images.
Full-duplex voice models for continuous listening and response. GPT-Live-1.1 succeeds GPT-Live-1 on Plus and higher tiers, and Quip succeeds GPT-Live-1 mini.
Hosted image model for prompt-driven generation and targeted edits at up to 2K, available in Krea at launch.
Open regional weather simulation system with a new downscaling model that predicts high-resolution rain, wind, and pressure fields at 3 km resolution.
Public weights for the hybrid reasoning model that was available via hosted inference in September. October 13 records the initial checkpoint upload.
Open-weight streaming Arabic speech recognition checkpoint, adapted from Voxtral Mini 4B Realtime and released in BF16.
MIT-licensed 3B and 29B video generation models with synchronized audio and lip sync. Released weights and code include a separate super-resolution model.
19B multimodal reasoning preview that uses shared state to understand, render, and interact with scenes. Dated by Reka's public research announcement.
Compact on-device speech recognition model with downloadable weights, packaged for the Needle runtime.
Speech model for customer-service conversations, introduced with Decagon Voice 3.

Uses the October 23 official launch announcement; the research index is dated October 24.

Moonshot reports 2-3 times the speed; this is a publisher claim. Moonshot released weights for standard K3.1 Pro on November 4. Highspeed is a hosted variant.
